title: [Bug] Weekly usage reset time displayed incorrectly for Pro plan users
body: **Bug Description** Subject: Usage weekly reset time shown incorrectly (Pro) Description: My weekly usage limit showed “Resets by 6:00 AM” (99% used), but I expected it to reset at ~8:00 AM ET. I did not capture the earlier screen showing the ~8:00 AM reset time before it changed. Extra usage is enabled. Plan: Pro Time I hit the limit: N/A - expected to hit but reset was extended by 5 days Time I expected reset: ~8:00 AM ET Current screenshot: attached (shows “Resets by 4:00 AM Friday Apr 24” and 99% used) Steps to reproduce: 1) Use Claude until weekly usage is near 100%. 2) Observe the “Resets by …” time shown in Settings → Usage. 3) Compare to the reset time previously shown. Attachments: - Screenshot of Settings → Usage (current state)Here’s a ready-to-paste bug report you can submit in Claude Code using /bug. Subject: Weekly usage reset time changed without a reset (Pro) Description: On Monday Apr 20, 2026, around 4:00 AM ET, my weekly limit showed it would reset at ~8:00 AM ET. Over the next ~8 hours, that reset time changed to Friday, but there was no actual reset and my usage was not credited back. I had already entered extra usage around 3:00 AM ET, and later received a notification I was at ~95% weekly usage around 12:00 PM ET. Extra usage is enabled. Plan: Pro Attachments: Screenshot of Settings → Usage showing “Resets by 6:00 AM” and 99% used (current state). Note: Weekly limits reset on a rolling 7-day window from your first prompt, not a fixed wall-clock time, so the “resets by …” time can shift as you keep using Claude. **Environment Info** - Platform: darwin - Terminal: Apple_Terminal - Version: 2.1.114 - Feedback ID: 16b83b6e-306f-4044-91f7-f8efd2a7880d **Errors** ```json [{"error":"Error: Failed to fetch version from https://storage.googleapis.com/claude-code-dist-86c565f3-f756-42ad-8dfa-d59b1c096819/claude-code-releases/latest: ECONNREFUSED\n at zF1 (/$bunfs/root/src/entrypoints/cli.js:2749:5253)\n at processTicksAndRejections (native:7:39)","timestamp":"2026-04-20T15:04:38.734Z"},{"error":"Error: Failed to fetch version from https://storage.googleapis.com/claude-code-dist-86c565f3-f756-42ad-8dfa-d59b1c096819/claude-code-releases/latest: ECONNREFUSED\n at zF1 (/$bunfs/root/src/entrypoints/cli.js:2749:5253)\n at processTicksAndRejections (native:7:39)","timestamp":"2026-04-20T15:04:38.734Z"},{"error":"Error: EISDIR: illegal operation on a directory, read '/Users/brandontaylor/Documents/CMU/CAPSTONE/Dark_Circle/crl-train/tests/data'\n at nKH (/$bunfs/root/src/entrypoints/cli.js:1564:144)\n at processTicksAndRejections (native:7:39)","timestamp":"2026-04-20T15:46:46.081Z"},{"error":"Error: EISDIR: illegal operation on a directory, read '/Users/brandontaylor/Documents/CMU/CAPSTONE/Dark_Circle/crl-train/training'\n at nKH (/$bunfs/root/src/entrypoints/cli.js:1564:144)\n at processTicksAndRejections (native:7:39)","timestamp":"2026-04-20T15:50:05.697Z"}] ```
